news.title: S&P 500 rises slightly as investors hope for last-minute Iran ceasefire: Live updates
news.description: Wall Street is coming off a strong performance last week, with the S&P 500 soaring nearly 6%.

news.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire proposal 'significant' but 'not good enough' as Hormuz Strait deadline nears
news.description: The 45-day ceasefire proposal, which could lead to an end to the war, is reportedly being discussed by the U.S., Iran and a group of regional mediators.

news.title: Robinhood, BNY to build Trump accounts app
news.description: The Treasury Department designated BNY as the financial agent to manage Trump accounts. BNY will also partner with Robinhood on a Trump accounts app.
